title: So easy to assemble!
text: So easy to assemble!. The quality of this bed is good. I especially enjoy the head board. It’s very easy to assemble. It took me less than half an hour!

description: The Zinus Faux Leather Classic Platform Bed with strong steel support is attractively styled and will provide excellent support for your mattress. It ships in one carton including the frame, legs, and steel slats for easy assembly. This Platform Bed features espresso colored button tufted faux leather upholstery for a luxurious look that makes an excellent addition to any bedroom. Another comfort innovation from Zinus. Pioneering comfort.
